records.name: New York Indian Council, Inc.
records.what: An Urban Indian Organization funded by the Indian Health Service. The Indian Health Service lists it as offering help finding and getting to health care (outreach and referral).
records.who: American Indian and Alaska Native people living in or near the city. Ask what proof of tribal affiliation or descent it needs.
records.start: Call and ask how to become a patient or client, and which services are offered at the site nearest you.

more.label: Indian Health Service directory of Urban Indian Organizations (phone numbers and websites)
